recipes.name: Arni lemonato
recipes.description: Lamb pieces braised with lemon, garlic and oregano until tender in a bright pan sauce.
instructions: Brown lamb in olive oil
add garlic and oregano
Add lemon juice, stock and potatoes
cover and simmer gently until lamb and potatoes tender, about 90 minutes
uncover to reduce sauce
season and serve.
recipes.substitutions: Use chicken thighs and shorten simmering time.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 3 days; reheat until steaming.
recipes.safety: Cook lamb fully and cool leftovers promptly.

recipes.name: Bakaliaros skordalia
recipes.englishName: Fried salt cod with garlic potato dip
recipes.description: Salt cod fried in a light batter and served with garlic potato dip, especially for spring feasts.
instructions: If using salt cod, soak in refrigerator according to supplier directions, changing water
Boil potatoes until tender
mash with garlic, olive oil, salt and lemon to make skordalia
Pat fish dry, cut into portions and dust with flour
Dip in batter and fry in hot oil until crisp and fish flakes opaque.
recipes.substitutions: Use fresh cod and season lightly.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate fish promptly and use within 1 day; dip keeps 2 days chilled.
recipes.safety: Keep fish cold and cook until opaque; use safe hot-oil practice.

recipes.name: Briam
recipes.description: A tray of courgette, aubergine, potato and tomato slowly baked with olive oil and herbs.
instructions: Slice vegetables evenly
salt aubergine briefly and pat dry
Layer vegetables and onion in a baking dish
add tomatoes, herbs, salt and olive oil
Bake at 190 C for 60 to 70 minutes, turning gently once, until vegetables are very tender and edges brown
rest before serving.
recipes.sides: Serve warm or room temperature with feta and bread.
recipes.substitutions: Use green beans or peppers in season.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate up to 3 days; reheat until hot.
recipes.safety: Cool vegetables promptly and keep chilled.

recipes.name: Paximadia me ntomata
recipes.description: Hard barley rusks softened with tomato and olive oil for a simple snack.
instructions: Sprinkle rusks lightly with water to soften
Grate tomatoes and spoon over rusks
Crumble mizithra on top
add olive oil and oregano
let stand briefly and serve.
recipes.sides: Serve as a light snack or starter.
recipes.substitutions: Use feta or toasted bread.
recipes.storage: Assemble just before serving.
recipes.safety: Wash tomatoes and keep cheese chilled.

recipes.name: Dakos
recipes.description: Barley rusks softened with ripe tomato and topped with mizithra, oregano and olive oil.
instructions: Grate tomatoes into a bowl and season lightly
Sprinkle rusks with a little water to soften without making them mushy
Spoon tomato over rusks
add cheese, oregano, capers and olive oil
rest 5 minutes and serve.
recipes.sides: Serve as a light lunch or starter.
recipes.substitutions: Use toasted country bread if rusks are unavailable.
recipes.storage: Assemble just before serving.
recipes.safety: Wash tomatoes and keep cheese refrigerated.

recipes.name: Elies Kalamatas me portokali
recipes.description: Kalamata olives tossed with orange, onion, oregano and olive oil.
instructions: Pit olives if needed
Slice orange and onion thinly
Toss with olives, olive oil and oregano
rest 10 minutes and serve.
recipes.sides: Serve as meze with bread and cheese.
recipes.substitutions: Use lemon zest if orange is unavailable.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate covered and use within 2 days.
recipes.safety: Use clean utensils when handling olives.

recipes.name: Fakes
recipes.description: Brown lentils simmered with onion, carrot, tomato and bay, finished with vinegar.
instructions: Rinse lentils
put in pot with water and bring to a boil
Drain once and add fresh water, onion, carrot, tomatoes and bay
simmer until lentils tender, 35 to 45 minutes
Stir in olive oil, season and serve with vinegar at table.
recipes.substitutions: Add celery or a little oregano.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate up to 3 days; reheat until bubbling.
recipes.safety: Cook lentils fully and chill leftovers promptly.

recipes.name: Fasolada
recipes.description: White beans simmered with tomato, celery, carrot and olive oil into a thick soup.
instructions: Drain beans and simmer in fresh water until nearly tender
Add diced onion, carrots, celery and tomatoes
continue simmering until beans are soft
Stir in olive oil and salt during final 15 minutes
mash a few beans to thicken
season.
recipes.sides: Serve with olives and crusty bread.
recipes.substitutions: Use canned beans and reduce cooking time.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 3 days; reheat until bubbling.
recipes.safety: Boil dried beans thoroughly and chill leftovers promptly.

recipes.name: Gemista
recipes.description: Tomatoes and peppers filled with rice, herbs and their own pulp, baked until tender.
instructions: Cut tops from tomatoes and peppers
scoop tomato pulp and chop
Cook onion in oil
stir in rice, tomato pulp, herbs and seasoning
Fill vegetables loosely and replace tops
arrange with potato wedges in tray
add water and remaining oil
Bake at 180 C until rice is tender and vegetables soft, about 70 minutes.
recipes.sides: Serve warm or room temperature with feta.
recipes.substitutions: Add cooked minced meat to filling.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate within 2 hours up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly.
recipes.safety: Rice filling must be fully cooked; cool leftovers promptly.

recipes.name: Giouvetsi
recipes.description: Beef braised in tomato sauce with orzo pasta until tender and saucy.
instructions: Brown beef in a heavy ovenproof pot
add onion and soften
Stir in tomatoes, stock, bay and cinnamon
cover and braise at 160 C until beef tender, about 90 minutes
Stir in orzo and bake uncovered until pasta is tender, adding hot water if needed
remove spices and rest.
recipes.sides: Serve with grated kefalotyri or hard cheese.
recipes.substitutions: Use lamb shoulder or chicken, reducing cooking time.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 3 days; reheat with stock.
recipes.safety: Cook beef thoroughly and keep leftovers chilled.

recipes.name: Horiatiki salata
recipes.description: Tomato, cucumber, pepper and onion with olives and a slab of feta.
instructions: Cut tomatoes into wedges and cucumber into thick slices
Add pepper, onion and olives to a serving plate
Lay feta on top
drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle oregano
Serve without tossing so vegetables keep their shape.
recipes.sides: Serve with bread to soak up dressing.
recipes.substitutions: Add capers or purslane in season.
recipes.storage: Prepare just before serving; refrigerate leftovers briefly.
recipes.safety: Wash vegetables and keep feta chilled.

recipes.name: Kleftiko
recipes.englishName: Lamb baked with potatoes and lemon
recipes.description: Lamb and potatoes slow-baked in a sealed parcel with lemon, garlic and oregano.
instructions: Heat oven to 170 C
season lamb with lemon juice, garlic, oregano, oil, salt and pepper
Arrange lamb and potato wedges on parchment
add lemon wedges and wrap tightly, then seal in foil
Bake until lamb is tender, about 2 to 2.5 hours
open parcel carefully and brown briefly if desired.
recipes.substitutions: Use chicken thighs and reduce baking time.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 3 days; reheat until hot.
recipes.safety: Cook lamb until tender; beware steam when opening parcel.

recipes.name: Kolokithokeftedes
recipes.description: Grated courgette fritters mixed with herbs, feta and a little flour.
instructions: Grate courgettes, salt lightly and squeeze very dry
Mix courgette with crumbled feta, egg, dill, spring onion and flour
Heat a thin layer of oil
spoon small patties and flatten
fry until golden both sides and cooked through
drain.
recipes.substitutions: Use mint or parsley in place of dill.
recipes.storage: Best fresh; refrigerate leftovers up to 1 day and reheat in oven.
recipes.safety: Cook egg mixture through and handle hot oil carefully.

recipes.name: Koulouri Thessalonikis
recipes.description: Chewy bread rings coated in sesame seeds, commonly eaten for breakfast on the go.
instructions: Mix flour, yeast, sugar, salt and water
knead until smooth and rise until doubled
Divide into 8 pieces
roll into ropes and join ends into rings
Dilute honey in warm water
dip rings then coat generously in sesame
Bake at 220 C until golden and hollow-sounding, about 15 minutes.
recipes.substitutions: Use molasses in place of honey.
recipes.storage: Store in paper bag for 1 day; freeze extras.
recipes.safety: Check sesame allergy and bake fully.

recipes.name: Kritharoto
recipes.description: Orzo simmered risotto-style with tomato, onion, herbs and cheese.
instructions: Cook onion in olive oil until soft
Add orzo and stir to coat
add tomatoes and a ladle of stock
Cook, stirring often and adding stock gradually, until orzo is tender and creamy
Season with oregano and fold in cheese.
recipes.sides: Serve with salad or grilled vegetables.
recipes.substitutions: Use feta crumbled on top instead of hard cheese.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 2 days; reheat with stock.
recipes.safety: Cool pasta quickly and refrigerate leftovers.

recipes.name: Lahanorizo
recipes.description: Cabbage braised with tomato and rice into a simple one-pot meal.
instructions: Cook onion in olive oil until soft
Add cabbage and stir until it begins to wilt
Stir in tomatoes, rice and stock
cover and simmer gently until rice tender, stirring occasionally
Add dill and season
rest 5 minutes.
recipes.substitutions: Use leeks or spinach for a variation.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 2 days; reheat until steaming.
recipes.safety: Cool rice mixture quickly and chill leftovers.

recipes.name: Melitzanosalata
recipes.description: Roasted aubergine mashed with olive oil, lemon, garlic and parsley.
instructions: Prick aubergines and roast at 220 C, turning, until collapsed and tender
cool
Scoop flesh and drain excess liquid
Mash with garlic, olive oil, lemon, parsley and salt
chill briefly and serve.
recipes.substitutions: Add yogurt for a milder dip.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate covered and use within 2 days.
recipes.safety: Cool roasted vegetables quickly and keep dip chilled.

recipes.name: Moussaka
recipes.description: Layers of aubergine, potato and spiced meat sauce under a creamy baked topping.
instructions: Slice aubergine, salt 20 minutes and pat dry
roast or pan-sear
Brown mince with onion
add tomatoes and cinnamon
simmer until thick
Layer potato, aubergine and meat sauce in a baking dish
Make white sauce with butter, flour and milk
cool slightly, whisk in egg and cheese
spread over top
Bake at 180 C until golden and set.
recipes.substitutions: Use lentils and mushrooms for a meat-free layer.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate within 2 hours up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly.
recipes.safety: Cook minced meat fully and set egg topping before serving.

recipes.name: Pastitsio
recipes.englishName: Greek baked pasta with meat sauce
recipes.description: Tubular pasta layered with cinnamon-scented meat sauce and thick bechamel.
instructions: Cook pasta until just al dente and drain
Brown mince and onion
add tomato and cinnamon
simmer until thick
Make bechamel with butter, flour and milk
cool slightly and whisk in egg and some cheese
Layer pasta and meat sauce in dish
pour over bechamel and bake at 190 C until golden and set.
recipes.substitutions: Use lamb mince or vegetarian lentil sauce.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 3 days; reheat until steaming.
recipes.safety: Cook meat fully and egg sauce through.

recipes.name: Peinirli
recipes.description: Soft oval bread filled with cheese and finished with butter or egg.
instructions: Mix flour, yeast, water, oil and salt into a dough
knead and rise until doubled
Divide into 4
roll ovals and pinch edges into boat shapes
Fill with cheese and bake at 220 C until bread golden and cheese melted
add egg near end if desired and cook until set.
recipes.substitutions: Add cooked bacon or mushrooms.
recipes.storage: Best fresh; refrigerate leftovers up to 2 days.
recipes.safety: Cook optional egg until set; keep cheese chilled before baking.

recipes.name: Revithada
recipes.description: Chickpeas slowly baked with onion, bay and olive oil until creamy.
instructions: Drain chickpeas and place in a covered ovenproof pot with onion, bay, oil and water
Bake at 160 C until chickpeas are very soft, 2 to 2.5 hours
Check liquid occasionally and add hot water if needed
Season with salt and lemon and rest before serving.
recipes.substitutions: Use canned chickpeas and bake for 45 minutes.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly.
recipes.safety: Soak chickpeas refrigerated in warm weather; cook until fully tender.

recipes.name: Ryzogalo
recipes.description: Creamy rice pudding gently cooked with milk, lemon and cinnamon.
instructions: Rinse rice
place in pot with water to cover and simmer until partly tender
Add milk, sugar, lemon peel and cinnamon stick
cook very gently, stirring often, until creamy
Remove whole spices
spoon into bowls and dust with cinnamon
chill or serve warm.
recipes.sides: Serve with orange zest or raisins.
recipes.substitutions: Use plant milk and adjust sugar.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 3 days; reheat gently.
recipes.safety: Cool rice pudding quickly and keep chilled.

recipes.name: Saganaki
recipes.description: Firm Greek cheese floured and pan-fried until golden with a squeeze of lemon.
instructions: Cut cheese into thick slices and pat dry
Dust lightly with flour
Heat oil in pan
fry cheese briefly on each side until golden and soft inside
Serve immediately with lemon.
recipes.substitutions: Use halloumi if kefalotyri is unavailable.
recipes.storage: Best fresh; do not store cooked cheese long.
recipes.safety: Use separate clean tongs and serve hot.

recipes.name: Souvlaki
recipes.description: Small pork pieces marinated with lemon, oregano and olive oil, grilled on skewers.
instructions: Mix oil, lemon, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper
coat pork and marinate chilled 30 minutes
Thread pork onto soaked wooden or metal skewers
Grill over medium-high heat, turning until browned and fully cooked
rest briefly.
recipes.sides: Serve in pita with tomato, onion and tzatziki.
recipes.substitutions: Use chicken thighs and cook fully.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate marinating pork up to 24 hours; cooked meat lasts 3 days.
recipes.safety: Keep raw pork chilled and cook through; avoid reused marinade.

recipes.name: Spanakopita
recipes.description: Crisp filo layers filled with spinach, feta, herbs and egg.
instructions: Wilt spinach and squeeze very dry
chop
Mix spinach with feta, eggs, spring onions, dill and pepper
Brush dish with oil and layer half the filo
spread filling
cover with remaining sheets, brushing each
score top and bake at 190 C until crisp and golden.
recipes.substitutions: Use chard or nettles in season.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate within 2 hours up to 3 days; reheat in oven.
recipes.safety: Cook egg filling fully and keep feta chilled.

recipes.name: Spanakorizo
recipes.description: Spinach braised with rice, dill, lemon and olive oil into a soft one-pot meal.
instructions: Cook onion in olive oil until soft
Add spinach and stir until wilted
Stir in rice and stock
cover and simmer low until rice tender, adding liquid if needed
Finish with dill, lemon juice and black pepper.
recipes.substitutions: Use chard or mixed greens.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 2 days; reheat until steaming.
recipes.safety: Cool rice quickly and chill leftovers.

recipes.name: Stifado
recipes.description: Beef slowly braised with small onions, tomato, wine vinegar and warm spices.
instructions: Brown beef in olive oil
set aside
Brown peeled onions gently
return beef and add tomatoes, stock, vinegar and spices
Cover and simmer very gently until beef is tender, about 2 hours
remove whole spices and season.
recipes.sides: Serve with rice, potatoes or bread.
recipes.substitutions: Use rabbit or chicken, adjusting cooking time.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 3 days; reheat until hot.
recipes.safety: Cook beef thoroughly and cool leftovers quickly.

recipes.name: Tiropita
recipes.description: Filo pastry filled with feta, eggs and yogurt, baked until crisp and golden.
instructions: Crumble feta and mix with eggs, yogurt and a little nutmeg
Oil a baking dish
layer half the filo sheets, brushing lightly
Spread cheese mixture and cover with remaining filo
score top and bake at 190 C until crisp and set.
recipes.substitutions: Use a mix of feta and ricotta.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 3 days; reheat until hot.
recipes.safety: Keep dairy filling chilled and cook eggs through.

recipes.name: Tzatziki
recipes.description: Thick strained yogurt mixed with cucumber, garlic, dill and olive oil.
instructions: Grate cucumber and squeeze very dry
Stir into yogurt with crushed garlic, oil, dill, vinegar and salt
Chill 20 minutes for flavours to blend
serve cold.
recipes.sides: Serve with grilled food, pita or vegetables.
recipes.substitutions: Use mint instead of dill.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate covered and use within 2 days.
recipes.safety: Keep dairy dip chilled and use clean utensils.

recipes.name: Yiaourti me meli
recipes.description: Thick strained yogurt topped with honey and walnuts for breakfast or dessert.
instructions: Spoon cold yogurt into bowls
Drizzle with honey
Scatter chopped walnuts and cinnamon
serve.
recipes.substitutions: Use toasted almonds instead of walnuts.
recipes.storage: Keep refrigerated and serve fresh.
recipes.safety: Check nut allergy and keep dairy chilled.
